newsitem.title: GERMANY: POLL-Buba seen keeping rates unchanged this week.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Buba seen keeping rates unchanged this week.

text.p: Following are the results of a poll of 10 economists on the expected outcome of this week's Bundesbank council meeting. The poll was conducted on Tuesday.
1. Will the Bundesbank change its leading interest rates
this week?
Yes 0
No 10
2. Will there be a cut in the discount and Lombard rates later this year?
Yes 0
No 10
3. Will there be a rise in the discount and Lombard rates later this year?
Yes 3
No 7
4. Will there be another fixed tender at 3.00 percent next week?
Yes 10
No 0
5. Will the Bundesbank change from a fixed tender to a variable tender this year?
fixed: 6
variable:3
no comment: 1
Detailed results of the poll as follows:
